messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great! Your phone now has excellent 5G signal with data enabled. Next, let's check if your messaging app has the necessary permissions to send MMS messages. The messaging app needs specific permissions to access storage (for media files) and SMS functionalities.

Please run the following check on your device and share the result:
- **check_app_permissions(app_name="messaging")** - This will show what permissions the messaging app currently has.

Once you provide that result, I'll guide you through the next steps.

The messaging app currently has the permissions for SMS, storage, and phone. What would be the next step to resolve the MMS sending issue?

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
